title: ErrorResponse
description: Body of every non-200 /v1 response with a body (DESIGN 3.7), including 202 in-flight duplicates (code in_flight + retry_after). Content-free by construction: codes are enums, validation issues carry paths and error types only, never the input (D20.7). 204 (DELETE /v1/me) has no body.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (202 in_flight, 429 rate_limited; mirrors the Retry-After header).

basic.description: 503 service_paused: true tells the client to show the basic card / ST-PAUSED (cap or kill switch).

min_app_version.description: 426 upgrade_required: the lowest supported app version (ST-UPGRADE).

ErrorCode.description: HTTP status mapping: in_flight 202, unauthorized 401, invalid_invite 403 (/v1/register), payload_too_large 413, invalid_request 422, upgrade_required 426, rate_limited 429, internal 500, service_paused 503.

ValidationIssue.description: One validation failure: the path into the body and the error type. Never the offending input value.

LocPart.description: A field-name path segment (schema field names only, so no content).
